hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: managed_inputs
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description:
Job will decode dbgap raw data and store it decoded dataset in s3.
Parameters: abv_name = Can be obtained from the Managed Inputs or JIRA ticket stdy_id = Can be obtained from the Managed Inputs or JIRA ticket

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail # Simple AWS S3 optimizations export AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS="${AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-10}" export AWS_RETRY_MODE="${AWS_RETRY_MODE:-adaptive}" export AWS_S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS="${AWS_S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS:-64}" export AWS_S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE="${AWS_S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE:-10000}" export AWS_S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD="${AWS_S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD:-64MB}" export AWS_S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE="${AWS_S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE:-64MB}" export AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT="${AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT:-10}" export AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT="${AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT:-0}"
mkdir data mkdir completed mkdir hierarchies mkdir processing
find data/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \; find processing/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \; find completed -type f -exec rm -rf {} \;
rm -rf uniq_ids.txt # pull data from raw data s3 aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
aws s3 cp --no-progress s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_name,,}/rawData/ ./data/ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "${stdy_id,,}*"
#--exclude "*" --include "${stdy_id,,}*"
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN

#!/bin/bash # decode data set java -jar jars/DbgapDecodeFiles.jar -dictdir "./data/"
EXIT_CODE=$?
# Log the exit code for debugging echo "DbgapDecodeFiles exited with status $EXIT_CODE"
# Prevent Jenkins from marking the job UNSTABLE or FAILED exit 0

#!/bin/bash
# Simple AWS S3 optimizations export AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS="${AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-10}" export AWS_RETRY_MODE="${AWS_RETRY_MODE:-adaptive}" export AWS_S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS="${AWS_S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS:-64}" export AWS_S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE="${AWS_S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE:-10000}" export AWS_S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD="${AWS_S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD:-64MB}" export AWS_S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE="${AWS_S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE:-64MB}" export AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT="${AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT:-10}" export AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT="${AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT:-0}"
# upload decoded files export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
aws s3 cp --no-progress completed/ s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_name,,}/decoded_data/ --recursive
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
